question: Under what repeated condition does that one remain unaffected by even slight agitation from them?
premises: The same condition as before is restated.
A group of feminine entities is referenced.
inference: Again, the condition is when that one does not undergo even the slightest agitation from them.
uncertainties: The identity of tāsām and asau remains unspecified in this verse.
plain_english: When that one does not go to even the slightest agitation because of them.
